guidebook.intro: Gamba bw’owulira era olage ti ofaayo ku balala.

tips.title: “I am happy”
body: Mu Lusoga eneewulira kikolwa: **nsangaire**, **nkooye**, **ntide**. Mu Lungereza kozesa **I am** n’ekigambo ekinyonyola: **I am happy. I am tired. I am scared.**

tips.title: Worried about …
body: Okugamba ekikweraliikiriza, kozesa **about**: **I am worried about the exam.** Okugamba ensonga, kozesa **because**: **I am angry because the taxi didn’t come.**

tips.title: “Sorry” ebiri
body: **Sorry** kitegeeza **nsonyiwa** bw’oba okoze ensobi: **Sorry, I am late.** Era kitegeeza **bambi** ng’omuntu alina obuzibu: **I’m so sorry! Get well soon.**

culture.title: Okubuuza ku buli muntu
body: Mu Uganda tubuuza ku maka gona. Mu Lungereza osobola okugamba **How is your mother?** oba **How is the family?** Okudamu: **They are fine, thank you.**
